# @kitr/cache

**Cache.** Remember slow results on the server and clear them by tag when the data changes.

```sh
pnpm kitr add cache
```

`kitr add` installs the package and wires it into your app: the provider in `kitrrc.ts`, its config file and its `AGENTS.md` section. Import it from `@kitr/cache`.

Read the guide at https://kitr.dev/packages/cache.

Part of [kitr](https://kitr.dev), the TypeScript framework where everything is an add-on. MIT licensed.
